profile: low-memory printed-text OCR and geometric extraction; not a general vision-language model
model_weights: Bundled inside the RapidOCR wheelhouse package; no first-run download.
memory: No peak-memory benchmark has been completed on the target RHEL host. Input defaults to at most 1,048,576 pixels and is capped at 40 million pixels.
limitations: Printed text OCR and table structure reconstruction use OCR coordinates and image geometry.
Flowchart labels are extracted, but arrow directions and branch connections are not inferred.
Graph labels and likely tick labels are extracted; plotted values are not digitized.
